name: Network Specialist Examination
name_ja: ネットワークスペシャリスト試験 (NW)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (April)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Deep network design and consistent recorded IPA/METI professional hints support professional infrastructure judgment; open eligibility and non-security coverage do not demonstrate an experienced expert practitioner.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded deep network-design coverage and the IPA/METI professional hints support professional design knowledge despite open entry. The paper exam and local recognition leave practical implementation and US hiring familiarity unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded deep network-design focus and consistent professional authority hints support design-level knowledge despite open entry. Its paper format does not establish expert practical delivery or dedicated security depth.
